decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8559. Series context: trend strength 0.4189 and seasonal strength 0.4572; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.002); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.364.
